description: Probes IRDI grammar basis, semanticId matching/versioning rules (Part 1 v3.0) and verbatim IRDI conventions and printing anomalies in the official Nameplate 3.0.1 and Handover 2.0 PDFs (primary vs supplemental, version-suffix drift, pair form, ~0 infix, cdp-URL-only rows, ECLASS 15 re-keying).

items.question: On which standards does the AAS specification base the IRDI identifier scheme used for ECLASS / IEC CDD semanticIds?

citation.quote: IRDI – ISO29002-5, ISO IEC 6523 and ISO IEC 11179- 6 [20] as an identifier scheme for properties and classifications.

items.question: Under the default (exact) matching strategy, do semanticIds 0173-1#02-AAO677#002 and 0173-1#02-AAO677#003 match?
items.expected_answer: No. Exact matching, the default, requires the two semantic IDs to be string-identical; only intelligent matching that ignores versioning treats them as equal.

citation.section: 4.4.1 Matching Strategies for Semantic Identifiers (Exact Matching - DEFAULT)
citation.quote: With exact matching, two semantic IDs need to be string-identical.

items.question: When ECLASS makes a semantically breaking change to a property, does it just bump the #00n version suffix of the same IRDI?
items.expected_answer: No. ECLASS keeps new versions of an IRDI backward compatible; a breaking change gets a new IRDI.

citation.section: 4.4.1 Matching Strategies (Intelligent Matching - Ignore Versioning, note)
citation.quote: ECLASS rules ensure that the semantics is always backward compatible for new versions; a new IRDI would be created for breaking changes.

items.question: Part 1 gives 0112/2///61360_4#AAE530 (IEC CDD) and 0173-1#02-AAI048#004 (ECLASS) for the nominal capacity of a battery. Is that an established IEC CDD to ECLASS equivalence you can rely on?
items.expected_answer: No. The specification says the example does not represent an existing semantic mapping; it is only a candidate.

citation.quote: Note: this example does not represent an existing semantic mapping; it is only a candidate.

items.question: In the Digital Nameplate 3.0.1 template, which identifier is ManufacturerName's semanticId and which is its supplementalSemanticId?
items.expected_answer: semanticId is the IEC CDD IRDI 0112/2///61987#ABA565#009; supplementalSemanticId is the ECLASS IRDI 0173-1#02-AAO677#004.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Table: elements of Submodel Nameplate, ManufacturerName row

items.question: A Nameplate 3.0.1 instance gives URIOfTheProduct the semanticId 0173-1#02-ABH173#003. Is that the primary semanticId the template prints?
items.expected_answer: No. The primary semanticId is the IEC CDD IRDI 0112/2///61987#ABN590#002; 0173-1#02-ABH173#003 is the supplementalSemanticId (pair flipped).

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Table: elements of Submodel Nameplate, URIOfTheProduct row

items.question: A parser emits 0173-1#02-AAM985#003 as FirmwareVersion's supplementalSemanticId for Nameplate 3.0.1. Which version suffix does the 3.0.1 PDF print?
items.expected_answer: #004: the PDF prints 0173-1#02AAM985#004 (hyphen lost at a line break, i.e. 0173-1#02-AAM985#004), so #003 lags the template.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Table: elements of Submodel Nameplate, FirmwareVersion row

items.question: What supplementalSemanticId does the Nameplate 3.0.1 PDF print for SoftwareVersion?
items.expected_answer: 0173-1#02-AAM985#004, identical to FirmwareVersion's supplemental; record it verbatim and flag it for verification rather than correcting it.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: Table: elements of Submodel Nameplate, SoftwareVersion row

items.question: In Nameplate 3.0.1, what semanticId does the SML GuidelineSpecificProperties carry, and should the pair be stored as two keys?
items.expected_answer: The ECLASS pair 0173-1#02-ABI219#003/0173-1#01-AHD205#004, printed as one semanticId string; keep it as one value, not two keys.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.question: Does the SMC GuidelineSpecificProperties__00__ inside that SML reuse the SML's IRDI pair as its semanticId?
items.expected_answer: No. The SMC's semanticId is the class IRDI alone, 0173-1#01-AHD205#004.

citation.document: IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment
citation.section: 3.5 Properties of the SMC GuidelineSpecificProperties, table header

items.question: Is the HandoverDocumentation 2.0 submodel semanticId an IEC CDD IRDI, an IRI, or an ECLASS IRDI?
items.expected_answer: An ECLASS class IRDI used as the primary semanticId: 0173-1#01-AHF578#003.

citation.section: 2.4 Attributes of the Submodel instance, Table 2

items.question: The Handover 2.0 PDF prints the Document SMC's supplementalSemanticId with a '~0' after the property IRDI. What exactly is printed?
items.expected_answer: 0173-1#02-ABI500#003~0/0173-1#01-AHF579#003 (plus the eclass-cdp URL); the '~0' is a printing anomaly to copy verbatim and flag, not to hand-fix.

items.question: What IRDI does the Handover 2.0 PDF print for the property OrganizationShortName?
items.expected_answer: None. It prints only the eclass-cdp URL https://api.eclass-cdp.com/0173-1-02-ABI002-003; an IRDI 0173-1#02-ABI002#003 would only be inferred, not printed.

items.question: Can a Handover Documentation 1.2 ECLASS IRDI be carried into 2.0 by just bumping its version suffix?
items.expected_answer: No. Version 2.0 updated all ECLASS IRDIs to ECLASS 15 IRDIs, marked as a non-backward-compatible change; every element has to be re-keyed from the 2.0 PDF.

citation.section: Annex C, Table 15 List of changes, change 2
citation.quote: ALL ECLASS IRDIs are updated with ECLASS 15 IRDIs.

items.question: In the official Handover Documentation 2.0.2 template JSON, what is the semanticId of OrganizationShortName: an ECLASS IRDI or something else?
items.expected_answer: Not an IRDI: the template uses the eclass-cdp URL https://api.eclass-cdp.com/0173-1-02-ABI002-003 itself as the semanticId (ExternalReference, GlobalReference key), matching the PDF print; do not substitute 0173-1#02-ABI002#003.

citation.document: IDTA 02004 Handover Documentation - official template JSON
